purpose: Channel-published Shorts proven (audio AND picture) to be cut from this episode. Positive anchors only, never the full answer key (CLAUDE.md, Ground truth philosophy).
method: Audio: 32-band log-mel (150-5000 Hz), 50 ms hop, first difference over time; every 6 s window of the Short (1 s hop) is cross-correlated (Pearson, per-band centred) against the whole episode; an ANCHOR = >=3 consecutive windows >=0.50 at the same offset (+-0.15 s), i.e. >=8 s of continuous match; inside an anchored episode, shorter pieces at other offsets are admitted (>=2 windows mean>=0.6, or one window >=0.75) and boundaries refined per frame (1 s local correlation >=0.5). Picture: for every audio segment, 3-12 frames spread over it; each Short frame is compared (NCC, multi-zoom crop-fill and letterbox templates) with the episode frame at the matched time (best of +-0.2 s) and with 3 random episode frames >=30 s away (same-frame null). A segment is picture-verified if median score >=0.75 and (median margin over null >=0.10 with >=50% of frames clearing null+0.10, or score >=0.92 with margin >=0.05). A Short is ACCEPTED for an episode only if it has an audio anchor whose segment is picture-verified, and >=25% of the Short is proven; otherwise rejected with the reason. Every accepted Short was also checked by eye on a 4-frame contact sheet (Short frame | episode frame).

thresholds.picture: median>=0.75 and ((margin>=0.10 and frac>=0.5) or (score>=0.92 and margin>=0.05))

audio_positive_self.note: each Short vs its own audio

audio_positive_synthetic.note: 30 synthetic Shorts (3 per episode: centre-crop, letterbox, letterbox+pink noise; 3 jump-cut pieces of 8-18 s, AAC 64k, 1/2 reordered)

audio_negative_other_series.note: real candidate Shorts vs episodes of OTHER series; every such anchor failed the picture check (shared background music)

audio_matched_but_picture_failed_real.note: audio anchors on shared BGM/songs (same series or same studio); picture showed different footage, 2 of them checked by eye (kbZgaboHx1o: Love Brew song over different footage; cGCq0Bagd9o: Queen BGM over a different scene)

rejected_rechecked_for_speed_change.variants: tempo x0.9/0.95/1.05/1.1 (pitch kept) and speed x0.95/1.05/1.1 (pitch shifted), undone before matching
rejected_rechecked_for_speed_change.positive_control: T5hJayVbwvo artificially sped up x1.1: window score 0.968-0.981, 82-window chain
rejected_rechecked_for_speed_change.verdict: no rejected candidate becomes a match under a speed change
